newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Light up on laggards buying.
newsitem.headline: China Light up on laggards buying.

text.p: Demand for laggards boosted China Light & Power Co Ltd shares to a morning high of HK$34.90, before they steadied at HK$34.80, up HK$0.30 from Tuesday's close, brokers said.
"Overseas funds were seen accumulating China Light as it was lagging behind the market following the recent market rally," a sales manager at a regional brokerage said.

Brokers said strong local residential sales recently had also renewed speculation of stronger company earnings in future in view of its joint residential development with Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd in Hok Un in Kowloon.
